validation.text_scan_scope: SQLite TEXT and undeclared-type columns; specified path, email, private-IP, and credential patterns
validation.printable_byte_scan_scope: printable byte sequences; specified credential, email, private-IP, and known local-root patterns
validation.scan_limitations: Pattern scans cannot prove unknown, encoded, mutated, or unrecognized credentials are absent; numeric/vector BLOBs are not semantically scanned.
validation.source_read_mode: read-only SQLite online backup; committed WAL content is visible; source main/WAL/rollback-journal hashes must remain stable
validation.raw_staging: OS temporary directory with owner/admin restricted ACL on Windows or mode 0700 elsewhere; crash leftovers are reaped after owner process exit
validation.publication: per-database SIRE lock serializes snapshot/index/migration; Windows file guards block database access during pair replacement; recovery marker and rollback copies repair interrupted publication
